blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan challenged on Friday newly-appointed Supreme Court Chief Justice Rodil Zalameda to bring back Filipinos’ trust in the justice system. Zalameda was appointed by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to take the place of Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo, who is set to retire on Friday. “Leading the reform in the Philippine justice system is the challenge to Chief Justice Rodil Zalameda,” Pangilinan said in a statement. The senator noted that Zalameda should see his appointment as “a challenge to restore the people’s trust in the judiciary, a challenge to have faster resolution of cases, fair implementation […]...
